notes.title: UPDATE NOTES 15.03.2025
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

We’ve been aware for a while of a bug affecting 2% of our players that significantly disrupted the game. We’ve identified the problem, and with this update, we’ve completely resolved it.

notes.title: S.O.V PASSENGER 23 IS RELEASED!
notes.notes: The wait is over—PASSENGER 23 is now live! Take on a late-night shift at a desolate rest stop, where eerie sounds and strange occurrences will push your nerves to the limit. Solve day-to-day tasks under flickering lights and unsettling whispers, never knowing who—or what—may appear next.
